title: Process each fact once
prompt: An agenda may contain repeats. Complete the conditions and arguments so that each distinct fact is reported once. Helpers: is_empty, take_first (removes the first item), contains, add and report. known is initially empty.
explanation: The loop removes every agenda entry, but records and reports only facts not already known.

title: A premise counter
prompt: One previously unprocessed premise of rule has become known. Decrease its counter; when all premises are known, record its head if it is new. Helpers: head(rule) gives the conclusion; contains tests membership; add records a fact; enqueue adds to the agenda.
explanation: A counter of zero means that every premise has been processed. The membership check prevents the same conclusion from being queued twice.

title: Try another rule
prompt: Complete backward search. rules_for(goal, rules) lists rules with that conclusion; premises(rule) gives their antecedents. prove_all checks every premise, and extend makes a separate branch list. Decide where a failed rule should allow another attempt.
explanation: Only exhausting all matching rules justifies the final False. A failed attempt does not prevent the next rule from succeeding.
